race.comment: SWITCH HIT (4) has been holding his form strongly, and he got to be within a nose of getting the job done here just over 2 weeks ago. He gets a similar set-up here, and deserves another winning turn. IMMORTALISED (6) was a beaten favourite last start after suffering a cardiac arrhythmia for the first time. That issue is often just an anomaly, and from the pole position, he is worth another chance, so follow your money. DANCE LADY (8) recovered from a poor start to score very comfortably here a month ago, and it was not that much of a shock, as she did carry some mid-market support. She remains in the same class, and is worth following up. CELESTIAL SPLENDOR (11) won a jump-out prior to a fair run fresh up. Expect sharp improvement here.
